notes.title: Gamma Update
notes.content:
Overhauled Tutorial System
One of the problems that I wanted to fix was to ensure that players had enough practice with rhythmic spellcasting before they fought their first boss. I overhauled the tutorial system in order to provide players with an initial challenge of executing spells at a high Spell-Multiplier. I noticed that many players would spam spell combos as a way to brute force their way through the first bosses, but as the rounds progressed the difficulty of future bosses would be insurmountable. I hope having practiced at the beginning with the rhythm interface will allow players to be proficient when it comes to juggling movement, combat, and rhythm all at once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/a9c05f1c56fe5864a2ca8a495ee11df33e6184d3.png

Improved Difficulty System
There are now two difficulty modes; Normal and Insane. The Insane difficulty mode is the same difficulty that the original game came with. So if you liked the original difficulty, then choose this mode. Otherwise, the Normal difficulty mode was designed to still be challenging, but with a more forgiving system.

In Normal difficulty, the Spell Multiplier reduction when mistiming spells is not significant. Your Spell Multiplier grows much quicker, the rhythm timings of spell combos are slower, and the timing window of combo inputs are more lenient. The amount of damage received is greatly reduced and the amount of health gained through healing is increased. Most enemies also heal themselves at a reduced rate.

New Bosses
Replaced The Level 1 Boss
I replaced the level one boss with the following character.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/d89ae13f6e1a309d578eefc1d9006392254f55d7.png

Added the Rodent Boss
The Rodent is a mechanical boss that spits fire.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/cfda74d4f0fd74bf6095bc0c5bccfd1a4383ba43.png

Added the Ice Queen Boss
The Ice Queen has a powerful dash attack. Be careful to avoid the ice cubes she leaves behind.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/c72ff4865d8482b437198ca5f4444bd4e0806320.png

Closing Remarks
For those of you who have played Spell Beats, I want to say thank you for your support so far. It has been a fun learning experience. I hope to keep improving, and I welcome critical feedback. Thanks. :)

notes.title: Darkness, Shogun, Terra, and Muriel.
notes.content:
Dark Mode
Updated the map to have a nighttime setting and to be responsive to auto exposure. These changes increases the contrast between dark and light patterns. The spell particle effects are now more prominent and stand out better against the background.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/a17bc8d7ea6ca37ac75dcc97fa64c113851a37c2.png

Muriel
Added Muriel from Paragon as the second last boss. Muriel is very difficult to battle against. She is fast and powerful. Watch out for her hammer throws. Despite her speed and power, Muriel is still just a stepping stone to the threat of the final boss. I can't wait to see someone get that far.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/311f20103d8eb351b59cfb3d9ba9a3c8ccba84d2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/0850a6838a4172e81538405c60993a461cc8d43c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/c408c903d9d51abe177ca5dbc3577c11f16e7139.png

Shogun
Added the Shogun skin from a Paragon character as the level 9 boss. Watch out for her fast melee slices. Shogun is a great starter boss to introduce players to learn the spell timings and to begin mastering spellcasting.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/aad6298fe990fd0e4b6f672d9828c5ac23af4a48.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/2fe3a129b92d5a6a1ad85f39616c11b329a6ad2d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/5c10ab84ca283a412247f74a5596f7d52ad370a6.png

Terra
Added Terra from Paragon as the level 10 boss. She will protect herself, but be careful trying to get behind her. She can be very quick and may surprise you at times. This should be a great character to master the parry spell against.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/aaeb4e26db45b5d8db4b37c929367fe368f19ecc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/2bb5ae06c3ac66604a0c57b31f19186a32d95260.png

notes.title: Auto Save System
notes.content:
Added an auto-save feature that saves at the start of every new level, but it only saves the highest level reached. Use the Continue button to continue from the highest level you reached and New Game to start from the beginning. It does not save progress part way through a level. You must always start at the beginning of the highest level reached when continuing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/4cf24b0df6ac742f22b3fd8abfa5b79be8b82b15.png

Any feedback would be greatly appreciated.

--Garett

notes.title: Level Rotation
notes.content:
I realized that the spell rhythm game mechanics needed to be introduced sooner.  So, I decided to move the spell rhythm tutorial from level 5 to level 3.

Changes

 Moved the spell rhythm tutorial from level 5 to level 3.

Any feedback would be greatly appreciated. Thanks,

--Garett

notes.title: Level 3: Elements Enemy Update
notes.content:
The amount of time played on the demo is well below average as shown by its Steam statistics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/6b123550aba26f6330bfaa2e23642582b74a1de3.png

Why do most players stop before the 10-minute mark? My current idea is that it is due to the difficulty of the Level 3: Elements boss. This idea seems to be supported after watching the play-through by Nomependente123.
[previewyoutube=I2MSrE6xqWg;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes
[olist]
 Reduced the damage that the Level 3: Elements enemy's laser attack does by half.
 Made the laser easier to doge.
 Added more information about how the elements of each spell will interact with the defensive elemental status of the defender.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999753/8bdeafb013cfe203a5912e6e2cb4791ed709722e.png

All feedback is encouraged and welcome. I would like to improve the player's experience for Spell Beats.

Thanks for your time.

--Garett
